preserved_originals.name: city_district_atlas
preserved_originals.prompt:
Professional original hand-painted 2D TOP DOWN game environment tile-art atlas for a mobile cats-versus-zombies survival roguelite.
A believable abandoned coastal city at night with wet cobblestone streets, broken road markings, small brick storefront roofs, dumpsters, parked cars, industrial fences, mossy stone alleys, neon teal/purple and warm orange spill light.
Coherent illustrated painterly style with clean readable shapes, strong texture and highlights, suitable for mobile 32-64px tile pieces. A packed square sheet of distinct modular ENVIRONMENT ART ELEMENTS on separate regions.
No words, no game HUD, no labels, no watermarks, no people, NO screenshot frames. Carefully composed source art for actual sprites and background textures.

No text, no backgrounds, no watermarks, no frame borders, NO code drawings. Real illustrated character art.
